title: Dynamic Pricing & Revenue Intelligence
breadcrumb: Solutions > Growth & Revenue > Dynamic Pricing & Revenue Intelligence
meta_description: Price against demand, not against last year's spreadsheet.

blocks.x: Price against demand, not against last year's spreadsheet.
The problem this solution exists for
Pricing decisions inherit batch demand models and competitor snapshots; elasticity is estimated, markdown timing is instinctive, and revenue leaks are discovered in the margin bridge.

Streaming demand sensing feeds elasticity models per SKU-location; price and markdown policies run through a decision hub with guardrails and challenger testing; every action carries measurement so the policy improves each cycle.

The solution runs on EEMS Platform and Fleet Management System: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with the evidence to defend every one.  The governed data estate every intelligence program silently depends on.
How it runs in an engagement

items: baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
gated pilot on bounded scope with the falsifiable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.
reference architecture adapted to your estate, with the integration contracts itemized.
the composed capability live on bounded scope, with evidence generation built in.
runbooks, SLO catalog and the named-pod accountability chain for production.
baseline pack, measurement method and the quarterly review template your finance team signs.

blocks.x: Prerequisites are modest and named: governed access to the core data sources, a named executive sponsor and a control owner, and a sandbox where the proof can run on real records.

items: Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails — 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
KYC refresh backlog cleared — 70% faster cycles with agentic file assembly

blocks.x: Deployed across Retail & Consumer Goods, Manufacturing & Industrial, Agriculture & Food Systems. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
